title: Manufacturer docs and wiring answers in the core
goal: The core keeps manufacturer docs and answers wiring questions from them
acceptance: The core stores manufacturer docs and answers a wiring question (pinout entries, sources) as NERV's wiring answer does; specs with invented docs
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
Owner data, export files and ID maps never enter Git

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: the docs and answer half of src/fpv-builds.ts. Not a measurement.
